answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 45 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The mirror register is checked at draw time, signal lists the eligible set, and vertex seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 45 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
